We offer open party 1/2 Day, 3/4 Day, Full Day, Overnight, and Multi-Day (seasonal) and FREE PARKING. We are located at Berth 55, right next to Berth 55 Seafoods, where you can enjoy a fresh seafood dinner with an awesome view before your overnight trip, or after your day
